name: AdaptiveRatioTracking
definition: An importance-sampled variant of ratio tracking that improves estimation by decoupling the medium's combined free-flight distribution from the sampling distribution, using a proxy for the null-free-flight distribution to favor larger free-flight distances.
summary: AdaptiveRatioTracking is an importance-sampled ratio tracking variant that decouples sampling from total extinction to favor larger free-flight distances and reduce variance.
